udf_spec.prompt_template: Given the year {year}, classify it into one of the following buckets: '≤2014', '2015–2018', '≥2019'.

final_sql: SELECT year_bucket, COUNT(*) FROM pg_temp."year_buckets" GROUP BY year_bucket
answer_hint: The final SQL aggregates the counts by year_bucket.
